steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type to Auction, representing the reverse auction flow.
Select the reverse buy auction template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product as the first line item.
Choose Plant Name for the product location.
Verify the selected delivery location was retained.
